name: pac-bench-probably-aligned
description: A dataset intended to assess alignment-related or safety-related behavior of models by providing examples labelled for whether model outputs are likely to be aligned/acceptable. It is designed for quick classification-style evaluation of model responses and alignment detection. The benchmark appears to be lightweight and aimed at binary or categorical judgments about alignment.
reputation: A small/community dataset with limited adoption so far, primarily of interest to researchers working on alignment and safety evaluation.
